item.tib: gsas mkhar yongs su rdzogs pa las lha rgod gsung gi sgrub pa'i sngon 'gro
item.coloph: sku gsung thugs kyi rgya gsum la g.yung drung gi rgyan bkod zhing g.yu lung shel gyi brag phug tu rgyas gtab nas gter du sbas phyis dus gsang sngags gling pa'i (pas) bka' gter ma bu kha sprad nas 'gro ba 'dul bar gzigs nas mdo smad pa bdag gis yi ger btab skye 'gro'i bar chod zhi bar shog
